title: Answer: higher intelligence presupposes a self-model

statements.text: Many higher forms of intelligence and adaptive behavior, including risk management, moral cognition and cooperation, presuppose a self-model portraying the organism as one entity enduring over time. Iterating the PMIR yields introspective and social intelligence.

sources.quote: Many higher forms of intelligence and adaptive behavior, including risk management, moral cognition, and cooperative social behavior, functionally presuppose a self-model
two entirely new forms of intelligence emerge
